Of the +1.83, +0.37 came with the first review's fixes in the shared stage: the unpack state primed before the first strip, idle work that ends a dropped task, judges a sliced unit by its recent median and an untimed one by its own estimate and gives an upload its own idle period in flight, a held reduced-motion cut that counts as a quiet moment, and the cut held only for a destination that shows the posters; +0.11 with the second review's: a sliced task's units judged against their own kind (CPU work or uploads), so a set-up unit does not hold back the strips after it, a head-of-queue unit that does not fit the idle period stepping aside for the first one behind it that does, so the posters' 1 ms import and 3 ms parse run at the TV on a slow CPU, and the 1K tier on a link the browser estimates at 3G or slower; +0.07 with the third review's: small uploads that go between a playing game's frames, one per idle period (IdleTaskOptions.smallUploads, so the posters' strips go up at the TV and the first flight has nothing left to upload), a queue hurried when a queued task turns urgent (the first departure), and no sliced task judged before three of its units of a kind have been timed. They live in the room chunk rather than the lazy one because a runtime import of three.js or of a room module from the wall splits them into a common chunk on the critical path (+2.2 kB, measured).
